item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Customer-managed keys for Azure Functions durable task scheduler
item.description:
Customer-managed keys for Azure Functions Durable Task Scheduler are now generally available for Dedicated SKU schedulers. This lets organizations use their own keys to encrypt workflow data.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Symmetric keys on Azure Key Vault Premium
item.description:
Azure Key Vault Premium now generally supports symmetric keys, using the oct-HSM key type with the AES algorithm. This follows the public preview introduced in July 2026 and makes symmetric encryption available directly in Key Vault Premium.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Transparent data encryption (TDE) in Azure SQL Database AES keys
item.description:
Azure SQL Database now supports AES-256 keys in Azure Key Vault Premium or Managed HSM as Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) protectors. This provides an alternative to RSA keys for protecting data at rest.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Database for PostgreSQL stable REST API version 2026-10-01
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server REST API version 2026-10-01 is now generally available. The release adds support for maintenance management, immutable backups, and multi-tenant encryption.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Large OS Disk Encryption for Azure Confidential VM migrations
item.description:
Large OS Disk Encryption (LOSDE) is now generally available for Azure Confidential VM migration scenarios. It enables migration of larger production workloads with the OS disk fully protected.

  • Source: Azure Updates
